# Broker management cutover preparation

These standalone resources are not registered or applied. The BHB website, demo, outreach workers, browser/crawler and full admin database remain home. Business hosts the dedicated production/sandbox broker and broker-only databases. Do not restore the full admin database into a broker target.

Root supplies the separate home/talos 1Password item `bighorn-byte-connections-management` with mode-specific management origins and credentials. The proposed Secret contains only those four fields and is mounted only by the web controller. No outreach worker receives this management capability. The single explicit `BHB_CONNECTIONS_BACKEND=remote` flag switches the qualified website release; image promotion is a separate root gate.

The final-switch projection omits Intuit provider app credentials from the web runtime while retaining every other currently supplied runtime field, including ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, ADMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEYS, ADMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID and ADMIN_LOOKUP_KEY for admin/outreach behavior. It does not remove fields from the shared vault item or remove any other runtime field. The matching outreach projection excludes exactly the same three unused Intuit fields and adds no management capability. Production broker crypto is fresh and separate because its old source has no broker records. Source remote mode must disable local broker work while leaving other website/outreach schedules intact.

Apply only after the new broker-only schema, mode-isolated data/keys, management API authentication and qualified website remote backend are ready. Coordinate exact source revision, final source inventory/fence, public TLS and root-owned DNS. Preserve public OAuth origins; browser handoffs never use internal service DNS. Root coordinates provider registrations and reconnect. All three MK/JM development accounting schedules stay held until usable DEV Intuit configuration and reconnect qualify.

Final cutover validation compares both generated Secret field sets to the old runtime snapshot minus exactly INTUIT_CLIENT_ID, INTUIT_CLIENT_SECRET and INTUIT_ENVIRONMENT. ADMIN keyring/key-ID/lookup and all other field values must remain unchanged; keep the source item fields during the rollback window.

The final qualified outreach image must also receive BHB_CONNECTIONS_BACKEND=remote in jobs, scheduler, mail, hourly-maintenance, daily-maintenance and MCP roles. Their shared environment anchor is expanded before overlaying, so the standalone patch names every role explicitly. This fences only local broker maintenance/key rotation; no worker receives management credentials, and outreach/admin encryption remains available.
